parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$(-2p)^2=(2p+6)(p+2)$, or $\frac{-2p}{2p+6}=\frac{p+2}{-2p}$. M1 — OE. Using “$a,b,c$ then $b^2=ac$”, or $a=2p+6$, $ar=-2p$ and $ar^2=p+2$, to form a correct relationship in terms of $p$ only.
$2p^2-10p-12=0$, giving $p=6$. A1
$a=18$ and $r=-\frac23$. A1
$s_\infty=\text{their }a\div(1-\text{their }r)=18\div\frac53$. M1 — Correct formula used with their values for $a$ and $r$, with $|r|<1$. Both $a$ and $r$ from the same value of $p$.
$s_\infty=10.8$. A1 — OE. A0 if an extra solution is given.
SC B2 for $s_\infty=\frac{2p+6}{1-\frac{-2p}{2p+6}}$ or $\frac{-2p}{1-\frac{p+2}{-2p}}$; ignore any subsequent algebraic simplification.
Total: 5
